title: Edge On-Prem Customer Sync — Week of Mar 9 (Prep + Actions)
content:
Meeting: Edge customer (Region: EU-WEST) weekly sync
Date: 2026-03-12 (prep for 2026-03-13 sync)
Owner: Samir Patel (SE lead)
Attendees (expected): Customer infra lead (Marta), customer SRE (Tomas), Hannah (eng), Diego (solutions eng), Priya (security), Samir (notes)

Purpose: quick status for on-prem/VPC install, escalate unresolved blockers, align on cutover window and final checklist items. Aim to keep <=30 minutes.

Agenda (12–15 min):
- 1) Roll call + last-week decisions (2 min)
- 2) Current milestone statuses and estimated completion (8 min)
- 3) Top 3 blockers and mitigation options (8 min)
- 4) Action items and owners + next sync cadence (2 min)

Recap of previous actions (what we promised last week):
- AP-1: Provide token-scope least-privilege doc (Samir) — delivered 2026-03-07, customer asked one follow-up on service account rotation cadence.
- AP-2: Patch test image for installer v0.9.2 that fixes non-root volume perms (Diego) — in PR, CI green, awaiting merge.
- AP-3: Firewall port list and IP CIDR examples (Hannah) — shared 2026-03-09, customer requested confirmation on egress DNS to vendor resolver.

Milestones (short list, single-line status):
- M1 - On-prem bootstrap + service-account provisioning - Owner: Customer (Marta) - ETA: 2026-03-14 - Status: in-progress (50%)
- M2 - Installer run (v0.9.2) in staging on customer lab - Owner: Diego - ETA: 2026-03-13 - Status: blocked (PR merge pending)
- M3 - TLS cert provisioning + ACME integration test - Owner: Priya / Customer Sec - ETA: 2026-03-16 - Status: at-risk (customer CA approval delayed)
- M4 - KV cache persistence validation - Owner: eng-private-deployments - ETA: 2026-03-18 - Status: planned

Top blockers (prepare short statements to escalate):
- Blocker A: Installer PR (#189) contains fixes for volume mounts; customer cannot proceed with staging runs until merged. Risk: delays M2 and cutover window. Mitigation: request PR expedite + temporary manual patch steps (documented).
- Blocker B: Customer CA root signing policy requires security committee approval — unknown SLA. Impact: automated certs cannot be validated for prod. Mitigation: propose short-term TLS via customer-managed certs uploaded to KMS; need acceptance from customer Sec.
- Blocker C: Network egress rules to vendor telemetry endpoint require IP allowlist update by network ops (change window Tue 03/16). If not applied, runtime health checks will fail. Mitigation: propose fallback to proxying through customer's NAT host; requires small config change (track as separate ticket).

Risk notes / non-blocking issues:
- Disk layout on older appliances causes slower KV flushes; performance ok for QA but flagged for prod testing. Consider adjusting pom/persistence tuning parameters for older HDD-based nodes.
- Helm values schema differs slightly from our docs; Diego to send a trimmed example values.yaml for their env.

Pre-meeting questions to ask customer (short):
1) Can security committee commit to a decision timeline for CA approval? (Yes/No + target date)
2) Who will be the network ops approver for egress changes and can we lock a maintenance window this week?
3) Confirm whether they will accept manual cert upload to KMS as a bridge.

Decisions needed in this sync:
- Whether customer accepts manual cert approach for initial prod (yes/no).
- Whether we can merge and promote installer PR to staging before final regression testing (temporary promote if customer agrees).

Planned action items (format: action — owner — due):
- Merge installer PR and cut staging image (if green) — Diego — 2026-03-12 EOD
- Draft manual cert upload runbook and rotation checklist — Priya — 2026-03-13
- Provide short-term firewall proxy config and sample iptables / NAT example — Hannah — 2026-03-13 morning
- Schedule 1-hour cutover dry-run with customer lab (attendees: Diego, Samir, Marta) — Samir — 2026-03-15
- Open customer-facing FAQ that lists "what to expect during cutover" (text draft) — Samir — 2026-03-14

Notes for follow-up after meeting:
- If installer PR merge delayed >24h, create a rollback plan for staged nodes (detailed steps + contacts).
- Track CA approval as primary dependency in PROJ-7123 and ping customer exec if no progress by 2026-03-16.
- Keep a short Slack thread #edge-customer-X-updates for quick escalations — Samir to invite customer SRE.

Quick tech appendix (one-line bullets):
- Required ports: 443 (api), 5432 (metrics to internal DB, optional), 123 (ntp) — already shared.
- KMS integration: AWS KMS or on-prem HSM supported; if on-prem HSM, need PKCS11 lib path and service account perms.
- Installer logs: /var/log/redwood/install.log (rotate daily) — collect with journald-forwarder for SRE team.

Styling / tone: keep concise in sync, escalate only top-3 blockers, majority of sync should be technical troubleshooting and sign-offs.

End of prep notes.
